gameConfig.title: Crystal Caves
gameConfig.description: A three-cave collect-a-thon platformer: gather every crystal, stomp the crawlers, dodge the spikes, and reach the golden door before the timer runs out.

sprites.name: hero
sprites.description: 24x30 green cave explorer with a rounded body, dark outline and a lit helmet band

sprites.name: crawler
sprites.description: 28x22 red slime crawler, rounded rectangle body, dark outline, two eye dots

sprites.name: gem
sprites.description: 22x24 cyan faceted crystal in a diamond silhouette with a white edge highlight

sprites.name: tile-solid
sprites.description: 32x32 blue-grey cave stone tile with a lighter lit top edge and a dark seam border

sprites.name: tile-platform
sprites.description: 32x12 violet one-way ledge with a bright top lip

sprites.name: spike
sprites.description: 32x18 red hazard spike triangle rising from the cave floor

sprites.name: door
sprites.description: 34x46 golden exit door with a dark bronze frame, glowing when unlocked

sprites.name: cave-bg
sprites.description: Vertical gradient from slate blue at the top to near-black at the bottom

audio.name: stomp
audio.description: Short noise burst with a fast decay, 0.35s

audio.name: caveAmbience
audio.description: Slow echoing pad with occasional water drips, loops seamlessly

keyboard: Arrow keys or A/D to run
Space, Up or W to jump
touch: Tap the level buttons on the menu to pick a cave
mouse: Hold near the bottom-left or bottom-right to walk that way
Click the upper area to jump

mechanics.name: ASCII level maps
mechanics.description: Each cave is a 25x18 character grid where # is stone, = a one-way ledge, ^ a spike, g a crystal, e a crawler, P the start and D the exit.
mechanics.implementation: buildLevel() walks the grid and instantiates static/physics bodies per character.

mechanics.name: Coyote time + jump buffering
mechanics.description: You can still jump 110ms after leaving a ledge, and a jump pressed 130ms before landing fires on touchdown.
mechanics.implementation: lastGroundedAt and jumpBufferedAt timestamps compared in tryJump() each frame.

mechanics.name: One-way platforms
mechanics.description: Violet ledges can be jumped through from below but land on from above.
mechanics.implementation: Collider process callback allowing the collision only when falling and the player's feet are above the ledge top.

mechanics.name: Stomp combat
mechanics.description: Landing on a crawler squashes it for 150 points and bounces you; side contact costs a life.
mechanics.implementation: Overlap handler comparing player velocity.y and body.bottom against the enemy's body.top.

mechanics.name: Ledge-aware enemy AI
mechanics.description: Crawlers reverse at walls and stop before walking off the edge of their platform.
mechanics.implementation: wouldFall() probes the level grid one tile ahead and below the enemy each frame.

mechanics.name: Gated exit
mechanics.description: The door only opens once every crystal in the cave is collected, then it pulses.
mechanics.implementation: gemsLeft counter checked in the door overlap handler; a looping tween signals the unlock.

mechanics.name: Time bonus
mechanics.description: Each cave has a 90 second limit; leftover seconds are worth 5 points each on clear.
mechanics.implementation: Looping 1s timer decrements timeLeft; completeLevel() converts the remainder to score.

mechanics.name: Persistent level unlocks
mechanics.description: Clearing a cave permanently unlocks the next one on the menu's level select.
mechanics.implementation: Unlock index written to localStorage through MEAMUS.storage.

monetizationHooks: Interstitial ad on every level complete
Interstitial ad every 3rd run on the game-over screen
Rewarded video to retry the current cave with the score preserved
Crystals bank into the shared meamus wallet for a hero-skin shop
Level-pack IAP placeholder: the level array is data, so new packs are a content drop
mobileOptimizations: Phaser.Scale.FIT with CENTER_BOTH; the 800x576 grid scales to any screen
108px virtual joystick with a dead zone plus a 96px JUMP button
Coyote time and jump buffering absorb touch latency
Static physics groups for terrain so only the player and crawlers are dynamic
Level select means a session can be resumed instead of replayed
Loop sleeps and audio suspends when the app is backgrounded
Progress and best score persisted to localStorage
